info.name: EchoGPT Backend API
info.description:
Production Postman collection generated from the live EchoGPT OpenAPI document (`GET /api/docs-json`).

**Base path:** `{{baseUrl}}` defaults to `http://localhost:3000/api/v1`.

**Auth:** Most endpoints use Bearer JWT. Run Auth → Login (or Log in as seeded admin) to populate `accessToken` / `refreshToken`.

**Coverage:** 63 Swagger operations mapped 1:1 (+ 1 convenience admin login alias).

request.description:
Reports application health. Database is critical (HTTP 503 when down). Redis and SMTP are informational optional dependencies and do not fail the overall status when unavailable.

**Swagger:** `GET /api/v1/health`

**operationId:** `HealthController_check_v1`

**Auth:** Public

item.name: Log in with email and password

request.description:
Authenticates credentials, issues a JWT access token and opaque refresh token, and creates a session.

**Swagger:** `POST /api/v1/auth/login`

**operationId:** `AuthController_login_v1`

**Auth:** Public
Convenience request to obtain an ADMIN JWT using collection variables. Not an extra Swagger endpoint — same as `POST /auth/login`.

Revokes the provided refresh token session (or all active sessions when omitted) for the authenticated user.

**Swagger:** `POST /api/v1/auth/logout`

**operationId:** `AuthController_logout_v1`

**Auth:** Bearer JWT (`{{accessToken}}`)

item.name: Send a chat message and receive an AI response

request.description:

**Auth:** Bearer JWT (`{{accessToken}}`)

item.name: Send a chat message and stream the AI response (SSE)

request.description:
Streams the AI-generated response using Server-Sent Events.

Event types:
- `chunk` → `{ "text": "..." }` partial assistant deltas
- `done` → `{ "userMessage": {...}, "assistantMessage": {...} }` after successful persistence
- `error` → `{ "message": "...", "statusCode": 502 }` on provider/stream failure

Failed streams do not consume successful subscription quota. Client disconnect aborts the upstream provider stream.
Pre-stream failures (auth, ownership, quota, validation) may also be emitted as an SSE `error` event after headers are sent.

**Swagger:** `POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages/stream`

**operationId:** `ChatController_streamMessage_v1`

**Auth:** Bearer JWT (`{{accessToken}}`)

**operationId:** `AdminController_dashboard_v1`
